verdict.rationale: AutoGen is fully open-source, pip-installable (autogen-gh-1, autogen-docs-9), with source on GitHub, and AutoGen Studio explicitly supports running teams in a Docker container for self-hosted deployment (autogen-docs-17); community reports confirm running it locally with Docker-based code execution (autogen-comm-2, autogen-comm-3). Missing for 10: no dedicated self-hosting/deployment guide (e.g., Kubernetes, cloud install docs) or explicit server-hosting instructions beyond the Studio Docker option.
